reason: Neither the specified 5m/8m live trial nor the separate exploratory 2m/8m trial showed a Claude attempt 1 in private verified-claims logs before its first deadline. Only attempt 0 was observed and terminally nacked in each trial. Without a redelivery, workspace dedupe, old-watcher supersession, and a fair attempt-1 deadline cannot be tested; this is not an established product failure.
observations: The active steven QA template was built from source db383fe with a 480-second start-build delay before its runner container. The dedicated QA Relay was actually launched from clean coder/agent-relay main commit 43a513659711f0a31bf1522a233c041df475bd4e, binary SHA-256 ff2dc8de8dc77b23b1490d82ea0867eba28f9c1950fb19c064ebff00d8095ee7. A separate 60-second smoke build emitted the delay marker at 17:18:40 UTC and stopped promptly when cancellation was accepted. Coder recorded canceled_at and final failed, which the tester explicitly accepted. The smoke workspace was deleted.

In the specified five-minute trial, signed debug claims for attempt 0 carried iat 17:42:44 and exp 17:47:44 UTC. One workspace and start build were created, with the 480-second delay marker at 17:42:52.510. No attempt 1 was observed before the deadline. At 17:47:44.242 Relay logged an applied non-retryable nack for attempt 0, Coder recorded canceled_at at 17:47:44.346 and terminal failed at 17:47:44.984, and the only workspace was absent by 17:47:58.942. The browser showed a runner-start failure after one attempt by 17:50:05.235; its exact occurrence time is unknown.

In a separately labeled short-budget probe, only Claude's dispatch deadline changed to two minutes while the build delay stayed 480 seconds. Attempt 0 carried iat 17:57:11 and exp 17:59:11 UTC. Again no attempt 1 was observed. Relay logged an applied non-retryable nack at 17:59:11.302, Coder recorded canceled_at and terminal failed, and the single workspace was absent by 17:59:27.578. The browser showed the same runner-start failure after one attempt by 18:00:40.334. Neither trial establishes what iat or exp a redelivered work order would carry.

Three independently reviewed, cropped browser screenshots show the first waiting state and both user-facing failure outcomes. A redacted Relay/Coder event excerpt and 348 pseudonymous status samples from nominally three-second polls, with two timeouts and some longer gaps, are public. The CSV timestamps mark poll starts, not completed API observations. Raw debug payloads, build logs, original screenshots and full monitor records remain private. A UI activity spinner was still visible after each failure; those screenshots do not time the failure transition. No manual provider retry or Cursor prompt occurred.

The 5m and 2m overlays were removed byte-for-byte. The QA Relay kept the correctly built latest-main executable as requested, restarted on the original safe config, and both pools were healthy. The last Coder listing found zero steven QA template workspaces. The new QA template version remains active with delay default 0.
